title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-12
lineage: Dat (Sony D8) -> VX Pocket 440 -> Sharp MV10 -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC ->CEP -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of a mixed show with strong Sugaree guitar work and solid drumming, but overall an uneven performance.
ai_review.review: The SBD recording is relatively clear for the era, offering a decent mix though the bass can be a bit hot. Musically the night is split – Jerry delivers an extended guitar break on Sugaree and the drums shine, yet the first set feels truncated and the second‑set material comes off as lackluster for many listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is uneven with several negative comments, while the recording is judged good; average of reviewer stars (≈2.3) leads to a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Relatively good mix for an early‑80s SBD; bass and vocals a tad hot but clearer than many contemporaneous tapes.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set unusually short (six songs) followed by a long 45‑minute break, leading to a disjointed flow; second set perceived as bland despite a strong drum segment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Extended, extra‑good guitar break on Sugaree noted positively.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums were highlighted as the saving grace of an otherwise disappointing show.
